title: acb operator provenance records
description: Operator-supplied provenance records (--provenance-records FILE, no default). Each key is a skill directory or extension package root relative to the audited PATH, as findings report it; its record replaces that artifact's .acb-provenance.yaml as a whole. Never read from inside the scanned PATH.

source.description: Repository URL as signing certificates and build provenance write it: https://, no trailing slash, no .git suffix.
